legend: Alice and Bob are playing a game on an array A$$$A$$$ consisting of n$$$n$$$ positive integers. Alice picks some i$$$i$$$ and sets A[i]$$$A[i]$$$ to A[i]$$$A[i]$$$ |$$$|$$$ x$$$x$$$. Then, Bob picks some j$$$j$$$ and sets A[j]$$$A[j]$$$ to A[j]$$$A[j]$$$ &$$$\&$$$ y$$$y$$$. Note that each player only plays one turn. The score of the game is equal to the sum of A$$$A$$$.
Alice wants to minimize the score while Bob wants to maximize the score. Find the score of the game if both players play optimally.
input: The first line of input contains the number of testcases t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤103)$$$(1 \le t \le 10^3)$$$. The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains three positive integers n$$$n$$$, x$$$x$$$, and y$$$y$$$ (1≤n≤105$$$(1 \le n \le 10^5$$$, 1≤x,y≤109)$$$ 1 \le x, y \le 10^9)$$$ — the size of the array A$$$A$$$ and the two integers being applied to the array.
The second line of each test case contains n$$$n$$$ positive integers A1,A2,…,An$$$A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_n$$$ (1≤Ai≤109)$$$(1 \le A_i \le 10^9)$$$.
Tests in subtasks are numbered from 1−20$$$1−20$$$ with samples skipped. Each test is worth 10020=5$$$\frac{100}{20}=5$$$ points.
Tests 1−4$$$1-4$$$ satisfy the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 103$$$10^3$$$.
Tests 5−20$$$5-20$$$ satisfy the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 105$$$10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, output the score of the game if both players play optimally.
note: In the first test case, Alice can choose i=1$$$i = 1$$$ so that A[1]=4|5=5$$$A[1] = 4|5 = 5$$$ and Bob can choose j=0$$$j = 0$$$ so that A[0]=1&2=0$$$A[0] = 1\&2 = 0$$$. The resulting array A={0,5,3,6}$$$A = \{0, 5, 3, 6\}$$$ which leads to the optimal sum of 14$$$14$$$.

In the second test case, an optimal solution is Alice can choose i=2$$$i = 2$$$ so that A[2]=7|6=7$$$A[2] = 7|6 = 7$$$ and Bob can choose j=0$$$j = 0$$$ so that A[0]=2&3=2$$$A[0] = 2\&3 = 2$$$. The resulting array A={2,5,7,1,4}$$$A = \{2, 5, 7, 1, 4\}$$$ which leads to the optimal sum of 19$$$19$$$.
